title: You judge!!
text:
You judge!!"

"BBC reporter: 'Sounds like you’re saying 1 Jewish life is worth 100s of 1,000s of Palestinian lives'"

"Israeli West Bank settler: 'No. MILLION. 1 Jewish life, it’s 10 million, ok'"

"BBC: 'That just sounds racist'"

"Settler: 'Yes. I know. But it’s the truth. Because God chose us'
